studio.bioP1: I'm a Senior Frontend Developer & Creative Engineer based in Italy. Currently Tech Lead at Agilae, where I build the platform that digitalizes Italian insurance agencies.
studio.bioP2: My work sits at the intersection of engineering rigor and visual craft. I believe that great software should feel alive: responsive, performant, and delightful to use.
studio.bioP3: When I'm not building production apps, I explore WebGPU neural rendering, design systems architecture, and creative coding. I write about frontend engineering, React patterns, and the intersection of design and code.
